scope: One coordinated recorded Stage41 evidence publication only. No concurrent external same-user process may rename the unique staging or output parent while the publisher holds an FD there. This is an operational assumption, not a security claim against malicious or uncooperative same-user processes.
basis: The r2 after-open output-parent RED and r3 after-open staging-parent RED prove the sandbox alone cannot prevent bytes through a preexisting FD after a concurrent rename. The proposed correction uses a fully closed staged file and atomic no-replace output install, which the r3 moved-output test denied before protected bytes. A single writer and one heavy lane can exclude authorized competing jobs, but cannot prove the absence of every same-UID adversary.
requirementsBeforeLaunch: Version publisher source to the current production docs HEAD and include this plan and review as exact pins and publication controls.

Independently review the corrected publisher source and exact filled binding, including unique empty staging/output parents, ownership, process/path audit, watchers or equivalent drift telemetry, sandbox policy bytes, actual Git common object store, source/ref/AC/disk guards and group cleanup.

Record cooperating agents/jobs and require no authorized cleanup or rename of the bound scratch parents during the lane. Any observed rename, watcher ambiguity, unexpected parent identity or child failure is STOP.
